shared_pool_risks: AttackEffects: glow 360, smoke 80, debris 80, pulses 24, decals 64, beams 320, fire 16; oldest particle/pulse retirement.
Boon bursts limited to eight and target links to two per render interval; recursive ice shatter competes for boon budget.
Beams are shared by projectiles, arcs and spark streaks in that order, so later effects can be truncated.
Glacial Wake/charge/spawn warnings share cosmetic pools; domain lifetime alone does not guarantee continued visible telegraph.
Afflictions: 128 actors maximum, five shared draws, flame/ember six per actor, poison/drop four, ice up to ten.
High-only bloom must not be required for baseline recognition.
known_absences: No continuous environmental steam/weather/spark particle owner found in production source.
No camera shake, chromatic aberration, screen-space shock distortion or floating damage numbers found.
No dedicated persistent primed-weapon status visual for Cycle Capacitor; normal projectile appearance retained.
collapseCorpse is an unused production export; freezeCorpse is the active death route.
